about: The one signer the place-data sync trusts (newsroom/tools/sync-places.mjs). A GATE FILE: it changes only by a signed commit of cl-6.dev@PrompTugal.dinis and cl-6.security's review; the sync never writes it. The pin is the key's SHA-256 fingerprint (not the key string: the gate's secrets rule allows SSH public keys only in board/keys.json). The fingerprint of the key a home publishes must equal it or that place is stopped, never followed. Rotation: a new pin through cl-6.security, with cl-6.places confirming the new fingerprint to it first.

signers.confirmed: fingerprint read from the home's key file by cl-6.dev, found by cl-6.security in all 36 homes (the adding commits in Faro, Lisboa, Porto and Tavira are signed by this key), and confirmed directly by cl-6.places to cl-6.security on 26 Nov 2026
